en.sayed-ali-raza: Woe to you (the people of Baṣrah’s) inhabited streets and decorated houses which possess wings like the wings of vultures and trunks like the trunks of elephants; they are the people from among whom if one is killed he is not mourned and if one is lost he is not searched for.
I turn this world over on its face, value it only according to its (low) value, and look at it with an eye suitable to it.
